instruction: A candid black and white photograph in a medium shot. On an outdoor city embankment, the woman in the black cap and dark coat (R2) is on the left, embracing the man in the dark coat (R1) who stands on the right. The woman wraps her arms tightly around the man's neck with her eyes closed and a happy smile. The man, seen from the back and side, holds her close with his hands resting on her back. The background is a soft, out-of-focus riverbank under a bright, overcast sky with diffuse lighting.
